method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill (and references/regulative.md), from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the rulings on negatives of 2026-11-04 and 2026-11-05; the dates in one module (built-in date functions, no daydate), the rules and exported questions in another, the cases in a third; three regulative rules (bring the action by the last day; s 30A (2) notice within the relevant period; s 30A (6) proceeding within 6 months) run by EVALTRACE inside exported questions that take only plain facts; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Limitation Act 1985 (ACT), A1985-66, Republication No 28 (R28), effective 26 November 2025, as deposited at ../../registers/source-bundle/A1985-66.txt
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is (c) Australian Capital Territory, used under CC BY 4.0; see SOURCE-LICENSE.md
seat: the person bringing a claim (the plaintiff): the injured person, the person defamed, the relatives or personal representative of someone who died, the child or the child's parent or guardian, the executor of an estate, the wrongdoer seeking contribution (lact-claims.l4)
focus: the provisions a claimant meets: the Act's own time limits for injury, death, defamation and contribution claims, and their postponement and extension (Parts 2 and 3)

checks.l4: stable l4 of VS Code extension legalese.l4-vscode 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset
checks.command: l4 run lact-dates.l4 ; l4 run lact-claims.l4 ; l4 run lact-cases.l4
checks.result: 148 assertions written, 148 satisfied, 0 errors, 0 warnings in every file (2026-11-07); a deliberately wrong assertion in a scratch copy showed as failed
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read. Expected values worked by hand from the text.

scope: In: s 4 (a); dictionary 'under a disability'; Part 2: ss 10, 11, 16, 16A, 16AA, 16B, 21, 21B, 21BA, 21BB, 21C; Part 3: s 30 (except (1) (e), (3) (a)), ss 30A, 30B, 31, s 32 (1), (2) (a), (4)-(6), ss 33, 34, Division 3.2 (ss 35-42). Out: ss 5-8A, 12-15, 17-20, 21A, 21BC, Divisions 2.3 and 2.4, s 32 (2) (b), (c), (3), (7), Part 4 (Division 4.4 and s 54 are in baseline-2026-11b). Reasons in NOTES.md.
